name: Video Compressor + Resizer!
description:
Video Compressor - Fast and High-Quality Compression

Easily compress your videos while keeping great quality.
Whether you want to save storage space or share videos faster, this app makes video compression simple, efficient, and secure.

Key Features
	•	Compress videos from Photos or Files
	•	Adjustable size and quality settings
	•	Preview before saving
	•	Save to Photos or export to other apps
	•	100 percent offline processing, your videos never leave your device

Perfect for users who need quick and reliable video compression without complicated tools.

In-App Purchases:
Some features are available through an auto-renewable subscription.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account.
Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
After purchase, you can manage your subscriptions in your account settings.
You cannot cancel the current subscription during the active period.
